contextReview.basis: Direct review: clear, sunny daytime East Asian urban running routes: a tree-lined riverside promenade with a city skyline, a sloping residential lane with a stone step, a shaded pavement past hedges and low apartment blocks, a street-side drinking fountain, and a riverside railing with apartment blocks and a bridge; hard direct sun with sharp shadows, blue sky and a visible sheen of sweat on skin. No rain is depicted; the wet paving at the fountain is fountain water. The East Asian urban region and the humid setting are the producer's reviewed mapping; humid is a styling setting, not a measurement. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: The handoff and READY.json record that the user explicitly approved these five female running editorials and full automation of this batch (userApprovedEditorials true, currentBatchExplicitAuthorization true; 2026-11-07). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The twig on the pavement, the hedge and the stone planter wall are the setting, not products. She is mid-stride in profile, so the tank's far side, the shorts' far side and the pouch's back and strap are conservatively reconstructed. Both runners and both socks are visible and listed as pairs. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual worn silhouettes, colors and accessories matched. Hidden fronts restored conservatively.

deck.ko: 세이지와 민트가 검정 러닝 베이스를 밝힙니다.
deck.en: Sage and mint brighten a black running base.
deck.de: Salbei und Mint erhellen die schwarze Laufbasis.

intro.ko: 길 위 작은 가지를 피하며 발걸음이 옆으로 튑니다.
intro.en: A small fallen branch turns the next stride into a sideways hop.
intro.de: Ein kleiner Ast auf dem Weg macht aus dem nächsten Schritt einen seitlichen Sprung.

body.ko: 세이지 탱크의 곡선 라인과 검정 쇼츠의 짧은 흰 포인트가 움직임을 따라갑니다. 허리 파우치는 상의 아래쪽에 납작하게 놓이고 회색 양말은 민트 화이트 러너로 연결됩니다. 밝은 녹색 계열은 한두 군데만 반복해 전체를 가볍게 묶었습니다.
body.en: Curved lines on the sage tank and a short white accent on the black shorts follow the movement. A slim pouch lies flat at the lower waist, while gray socks lead into mint-white runners. Repeating the green tones in just two places keeps the combination light.
body.de: Gebogene Linien am salbeigrünen Top und ein kurzer weißer Akzent an den schwarzen Shorts begleiten die Bewegung. Die schmale Tasche liegt flach am unteren Bund, graue Socken führen zu mint-weißen Schuhen. Zwei grüne Akzente halten die Kombination leicht.

pull.en: An unexpected step can stay light.
pull.de: Auch ein unerwarteter Schritt bleibt leicht.

copy.pullQuoteEn: An unexpected step can stay light.

tip.ko: 허리 파우치의 긴 끈은 정리하고 탱크 옆선이 남도록 위치를 낮추세요.
tip.en: Tuck away loose pouch straps and keep the tank's side lines visible.
tip.de: Lose Taschengurte verstauen und die Seitenlinien des Tops sichtbar lassen.

howToWear.en: Place the black pouch low enough to keep the side lines visible.
howToWear.de: Die schwarze Tasche tief genug für sichtbare Seitenlinien tragen.
